name: Nikolai Netopyrev
description: An erratic, violent scientist whose experiments brought his life to ruin and his afterlife to infamy, exploring the Crucible cautiously and with questionable intent.

name: Erin
description: A god-like ruler of a mystical land, drained of her power and now scrambling to have agency in a world that doesn't always cater to her liking.

name: Voira
description: A fanatical archaeologist who has studied The Renegade and its runes for centuries, and was warped into this strange world in the midst of her greatest discovery yet.
